# AS USA

> > AS USA is a comprehensive English-language sports and entertainment news platform covering major leagues (NFL, NBA, soccer), international tournaments, and celebrity content.

AS USA provides breaking news, scores, standings, stats and analysis across multiple sports including soccer (Premier League, LaLiga, Champions League, MLS, USMNT), NFL, NBA, NCAA basketball, and MLB. The site also features entertainment news, video highlights, photo galleries, and gaming coverage through its MeriStation vertical.

## Key Topics

- March Madness
- NCAA Basketball
- Premier League
- LaLiga
- Champions League
- Real Madrid
- MLS
- USMNT
- NFL
- NBA
- Player Transfers
- Match Scores & Standings
- Tournament Coverage
- Entertainment News
- Sports Videos

## Major Sports Coverage

- [Soccer News, Scores, Standings, Stats and Rumors](https://en.as.com/soccer): Comprehensive soccer coverage including MLS, LaLiga, Premier League, Champions League and international matches
- [NFL News, Scores, Standings, Stats and Rumors](https://en.as.com/nfl): NFL news, scores, standings, stats and rumors for all teams and players
- [NBA News, Scores, Standings, Stats and Rumors](https://en.as.com/nba): NBA news, scores, standings, stats covering LeBron James, Luka Doncic and WNBA
- [AS USA Homepage](https://en.as.com): AS USA homepage with multi-sport coverage: soccer, NFL, NBA, MLB, golf and breaking news
